description: In an unsettling turn of events, a small finance bank and a vehicle recovery operator seized a customer's truck even though loan payments were consistently made. This incident resulted in considerable financial loss and emotional turmoil for the customer. The Punjab consumer commission ruled that they must compensate the customer with Rs 5 lakh and underscored the importance of adhering to legal protocols during vehicle repossessions to avoid similar injustices.
title: Paid every EMI, still lost his truck: Consumer court hits bank with Rs 5 lakh fine

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Rumors suggest that Jeff Bezos has made a significant investment in a beach house located in Miami's Golden Beach, priced at $69.5 million. The property was acquired through a Delaware LLC for privacy reasons, and while confirmation of Bezos' purchase is pending, it could enhance his extensive real estate holdings in Florida. This new home is conveniently situated just 30 minutes from his current residence in Indian Creek.
title: Jeff Bezos may be buyer of $69.5 million Florida mansion, locals speculate

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila while attending the 49th Asean Summit. He offered prayers and expressed his feelings of gratitude on social media. Several dignitaries, including senator H.E Francis Joseph Escudero, attended the visit. Established in 1901, Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan is the oldest in the Philippines and serves the Sikh community. It plays a vital role in linking the Indian-Sikh community with Philippine society.
title: Watch: PM Modi visits Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila, offers prayers

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Shubman Gill arrived early with Gurnoor Brar, and Kane Williamson arranged a camp for his former Gujarat Titans teammate before the ODI series got underway. In an exclusive conversation with TOI, Williamson, who has released his autobiography, "The Bare Margins", opens up about his bond with Gill and the two-Test series.
title: Shubman Gill's hunger and appetite to improve set him apart: Kane Williamson

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In Mohali, the Mai Bhago Armed Forces Preparatory Institute is preparing young women for careers in the Armed Forces. Seventeen cadets achieved success by clearing the NDA written examination recently. This accomplishment marks the highest number of successful candidates from the institute in its history. The rigorous training and support provided by the institute contribute to their achievements. Cadets now focus on the next stage, the Services Selection Board assessment.
title: 17 girls clear NDA written exam, gardener’s daughter among them

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: On November 14, Michael J. Fox led a remarkable fundraising gala for Parkinson's research in New York, amassing a historic $6 million for scientific endeavors. This gathering featured Fox and his family making a rare appearance, along with musical acts and notable celebrity attendees. Since its establishment in 2000, the foundation he founded has invested over $2.
title: Michael J. Fox's charity raises $6m at gala; $2.5bn directed to research

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Leander Paes has entered the AITA vice-president's race, backing interim president Chintan Parikh and the 'Tennis First' group. Outlining his vision for Indian tennis, the Olympic medallist stressed administrative transparency, accountability, grassroots development and better funding. He also called for former players to come together to strengthen the sport and build its next generation.
title: 'All of us are going to be accountable': Leander Paes on his vision for AITA

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Dr Michael Freeman’s examination of Epstein’s autopsy file raises questions about the nature of his death, suggesting that the injuries sustained are indicative of homicide rather than suicide. He points to signs of a struggle and possible strangulation. In contrast, the New York City medical examiner’s office stands firm on its suicide ruling, but Freeman’s assertions have reignited public interest in conspiracy theories surrounding Epstein’s untimely demise.
title: Jeffrey Epstein did not commit suicide, was likely killed: Top forensic expert

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Man sues brother over mother's estate; court upholds $11,000 fees against him

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: In simpler terms, a fast bowler has to be prepared to run into the wind and put in the hard yards for extended periods during a Test match. Former New Zealand fast bowler Shane Bond says both Wellington and Christchurch are windy cities, but the strength of the wind makes the former a little more challenging. He expects someone to do the "donkey work" for an extended period when the action gets underway on November 19.
title: 'Donkey work' awaits Bumrah & Co: Bond, Mills on Wellington's challenge

author: PRIYANGI AGARWAL
description: Delhi recorded no severe air quality days during its most polluted period from November 1 to 15. Historically, the city experienced high pollution levels during these dates in previous years. The average Air Quality Index was lower this year compared to last year and similar to 2022's figures. Contributing factors included better meteorological conditions and effective regulations under the Graded Response Action Plan.
title: First since 2015: No 'severe' AQI days for Delhi during November 1-15

author: YASHIKA BAJAJ
description: A tragic accident occurred in Tehri district, Uttarakhand, where a bus fell into a ravine. The bus was carrying approximately 30 to 35 passengers at the time of the incident. Rescue operations were launched promptly by the State Disaster Response Force teams on site. Four fatalities have been confirmed, and around 20 injured passengers are being transported to nearby hospitals.
title: 6 dead, 20 injured as bus falls into ravine in Uttarakhand

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Clavicular's girlfriend, Lily Snyder, has defended her decision to shave her head despite facing online backlash. The influencer suggested the makeover could help address his acne concerns linked to hair products. However, his representatives insist Snyder made the choice willingly and has no regrets. She had also considered donating her long hair, although her bleached locks may not qualify. Snyder reportedly plans to explore other donation options.
title: Clavicular’s girlfriend Lily Snyder breaks silence after shaving her head amid backlash

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Christian Anthony Claudio, 25, was arrested in New York and faces possible extradition to Mississippi after allegedly contacting police about the death of 18-year-old Nolan Xavier Wells. Claudio claims he only sought answers and never threatened anyone. However, authorities have not publicly disclosed the charges or released the warrant details. His November 16 court hearing could determine the next steps in the extradition process.
title: Nolan Wells murder case: New York man faces extradition over alleged police query

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Mitchell Santner has been ruled out of the upcoming Test series against India due to a hand fracture. His injury occurred while batting in the fifth ODI against India, confirmed by scans. Dean Foxcroft has been named as his replacement in the Test squad led by Tom Latham. New Zealand Cricket will provide updates regarding Santner's recovery timeline later.
title: New Zealand suffer major injury blow ahead of India Test series

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Reflecting on her past, Shehnaz Shah shares how she longed for a younger brother during Chhath Puja. After hearing a friend's inspiring experience, she earnestly prayed for a sibling, and soon her wish became a reality with the birth of her brother Armaan the next year. Her narrative beautifully illustrates the purity of childhood desires and the bonds that unite people from different backgrounds through love and community experiences.
title: ‘I asked Chhathi Maiya for a little brother’: Shehnaz Shah’s Chhath wish

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
title: Manhattan 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' townhouse sells for $11.5m, 65 years on

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Tuesday, oil prices dropped slightly as expectations of a global supply surplus gained traction. Analysts observed that geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are now having a diminished impact on pricing. According to the International Energy Agency, there is an anticipated surplus for the last quarter of the year.
title: Oil prices fall as rising supply outweighs Middle East tensions

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A legal tussle erupted over a narrow patch of grass between two Indiana neighbors, culminating in a ruling by the Indiana Court of Appeals. They upheld a previous decision in favor of the Goldfarbs, the neighboring property owners. Deanne Ellen Gloppen, attempting to claim ownership via adverse possession, fell short of proving her tax payments included the contested area.
title: Indiana woman who owned home since 1989 loses fight over 1-foot fence shift

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The US Department of Labor is tightening regulations for companies looking to sponsor foreign workers for Green Cards. Employers will now have to demonstrate efforts to recruit qualified American candidates before hiring overseas. The introduction of new advertising techniques, such as online postings, aims to enhance job visibility. Additionally, organizations that have recently laid off US workers may face limitations on applying for PERM.
title: US govt proposes new rules for Green Cards; says American workers are best

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India's captain Shubman Gill announced the team's plan to field four fast bowlers in the upcoming Test. The series against New Zealand poses a bigger challenge compared to the recently concluded ODI series. Jasprit Bumrah is expected to lead the pace attack with several other bowlers competing for spots. Meanwhile, Gill expressed confidence in wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant's abilities despite his fitness concerns.
title: 'We will play four fast bowlers': Shubman Gill ahead of first Test vs New Zealand

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: US intelligence indicates that Iran is potentially orchestrating attacks against senior officials, possibly utilizing dirty bombs or chemical weapons. Despite heightened contingency preparations from American authorities, no immediate credible threat has been pinpointed. Additionally, concerns have emerged regarding the likelihood of these weapons being targeted towards US military personnel in the Middle East, although officials question Iran's ability to implement such plans successfully.
title: Iran planning dirty bomb attack in Washington, US intel warns

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Miami Sheriff’s office hired a law firm run by his friend Israel Reyes to manage asset seizures under a deal allowing the firm to keep up to 35% of the assets recovered. The arrangement has raised ethics concerns as businesses face $45 million in seizures without criminal charges, while the firm’s revenue reportedly surged 2,325%.
title: Miami Sheriff’s friend’s firm keeps 35% of seized assets in $45M row

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Celebrating Grey's first birthday, Cardi B organized a grand party filled with a space theme inspired by her son's imagination. The celebration featured an impressive rocket ship entrance, a vibrant ball pit, and a giant LED robot dancing to the beat. There's speculation about the attendance of Grey’s father, Stefon Diggs, amidst their fluctuating relationship since welcoming their son in November 2025.
title: Cardi B absent from Stefon Diggs’ son’s first birthday?

author: REEBA ZACHARIAH
description: Breaking his silence, Jimmy Tata, Ratan Tata's younger brother, has questioned developments that, in his view, could concentrate influence within a narrower group of trustees.
title: Tata Sons facing 'back-door takeover', warns Jimmy Tata

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce praised Patrick Mahomes for bringing the Kansas City Chiefs' returning players and new receivers together before organised team activities in 2023. Mahomes arranged early offseason workouts in Texas to build chemistry and establish team unity. Kelce credited the quarterback's initiative and work ethic for helping newcomers adjust quickly. The Chiefs later defeated the Philadelphia Eagles 38-35 in Super Bowl LVII, securing another championship.
title: Travis Kelce lauds Patrick Mahomes’ leadership in strengthening Chiefs’ winning culture

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Rory McIlroy's eighth Race to Dubai title became an emotional moment after he dedicated it to his father, Gerry, who is recovering from a double-lung transplant. From working long hours to fund Rory's childhood golf dream to supporting him through major victories, Gerry has been part of his journey. His request before Dubai gave Rory one more reason to win.
title: Rory McIlroy’s father worked 100-hour weeks to make his Masters dream come true

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A man’s mother had been assigned Grama Natham land. After her death, the man continued to occupy the property and applied for the patta to be transferred in his favour as her legal heir. While his application was pending, revenue authorities initiated proceedings under the Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act, 1905. The Land Revenue Inspector issued a notice under Section 7, followed by a notice under Section 6 issued by the Revenue Tahsildar.
title: Son seeks patta for land given to mother, faces eviction; why court denied relief

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Madagascar has launched the Ala Velona initiative to safeguard its precious forests and tackle climate change. This ambitious project aims to conserve 4 million hectares of woodland while also generating valuable carbon credits. By showcasing the critical need to protect the island's rich biodiversity and ecosystems, the initiative reinforces the link between environmental stewardship and community livelihoods, highlighting a broader trend toward sustainable resource practices.
title: Madagascar seeks carbon-credit funding to protect 4m hectares, 55% of forests

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An expedition around Gau Island aimed at finding the critically endangered Fiji petrel did not result in any sightings. However, researchers gathered crucial information regarding its call from conversations with local residents. This engagement underlined the vital role that community involvement plays in forest conservation and controlling invasive species, suggesting that collective efforts are key to safeguarding the potential nesting sites of this rare bird.
title: 10-day hunt finds no rare Fiji seabird, but uncovers its only recorded call

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A woman and her granddaughter jointly held a locker at SBI’s Gunfoundry branch in Hyderabad. While the granddaughter was residing in Canada, the grandmother operated the locker in Hyderabad. The two alleged that they had deposited jewellery, pure gold coins, gold bars and melted gold weighing approximately 200 grams in the locker in 2015. They also said they had taken a photograph of the articles kept inside.
title: Woman, granddaughter allege gold missing from locker; but commission rejects claim

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Kyle Mills, who took a solitary wicket in the match, still remembers getting Team India head coach Gautam Gambhir out leg before wicket, but he had overstepped, which gave the southpaw an early reprieve. Mills feels it could have been a different story had they taken the early wicket, but it wasn't meant to be.
title: 'Dravid batted us into submission': Mills recalls India's 2009 triumph

author: TNN
description: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna remained upbeat on India, saying the company is expanding its footprint in the country and is hiring more.
title: IBM in talks for 2 large projects in India: CEO Arvind Krishna

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: United Airlines tech outage: What happened during 2-hour flight disruption

author: TNN
description: The meeting that will likely draw maximum attention in India and possibly Japan is the Quad leaders' summit - the first such meeting since Trump returned to the White House.
title: Ties with Asean crucial for India's Act East Policy: PM

author: PERVEZ IQBAL SIDDIQUI
description: Despite ongoing expectations, talks on seat-sharing between Congress and the Samajwadi Party for the UP elections have yet to materialize. SP officials have stated they have not been approached by Congress to discuss negotiations. Both parties remain dedicated to the INDIA alliance with the goal of defeating the BJP in the upcoming elections.
title: Buzz over Congress, SP seat-sharing talks today fizzles out

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A landmark court decision has established that buyers can return items purchased online within 14 days of receiving them. A University of Leicester professor successfully challenged retail titan Argos over the return of a laptop. The Court of Appeal ruled that activating pre-installed software does not forfeit the right to a refund. This ruling enhances consumer protection for electronics in the UK, prompting retailers to rethink their return policies.
title: Turning on laptop didn't void refund, Court of Appeal rules in Argos case

author: GEORGE MENDONCA
description: Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd has received a stop-work order for the Tarali pumped storage project in Maharashtra. The order was issued due to the absence of necessary approvals from the National Board for Wildlife. Allegations have arisen regarding the company's misrepresentation of project costs to reduce statutory obligations. Adani has stated that all required permissions and clearances were obtained before commencing work.
title: Maharashtra stops work on Adani project at centre of fee-cut row
